displayName: Function apps should enable configuration routing to Azure Virtual Network
description: By default, configuration traffic (image pull, content share, backup/restore) is not routed through regional VNET integration. For API < 2024-11-01, set 'vnetImagePullEnabled', 'vnetContentShareEnabled', 'vnetBackupRestoreEnabled' to true. For API >= 2024-11-01, set the corresponding 'outboundVnetRouting' properties or 'outboundVnetRouting.allTraffic' to true. Not for Flex/Consumption plans. Learn more: https://aka.ms/appservice-vnet-configuration-routing.

metadata.description: Enable or disable the execution of the policy
